slug: 2025-10-06 BoU's New Payment System Cuts Delays and Boosts E-Money by 28.6%

facts.fact: Uganda takes part in the East African Payment System, with inflows of UGX 1.3 trillion in FY2024/25, 99% in Kenyan and Tanzanian currency.
EAPS inflows were UGX 1.3 trillion, up 17%, in FY2024/25, per the Bank of Uganda report.
